Distinction

Reasoning begins by allowing one state, mark, or object to be told apart from another.

editorialfoundations · logic
Run a related experimentTrace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

Reasoning begins by allowing one state, mark, or object to be told apart from another.

EXACT

The compact statement

QEVA treats distinction as a declared primitive relation D(a,b) for a chosen context; it does not assert that one metaphysical notion of difference is forced on every framework.

Example

The marks ○ and ● are distinguishable by fill in a visual encoding.

Boundary / caveat

A distinction always depends on what an observer, test, language, or structure can detect.

Assumptions

  • The declared preformal metalanguage context is fixed.
